name: aishield-debt
description: AIShield Debt — AI-assisted security and technical-debt scanning platform

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @aishield/api && npm run build --workspace @aishield/worker && npm run build --workspace @aishield/ai-analyzer && npm run build --workspace @aishield/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev --workspace @aishield/api" "npm run dev --workspace @aishield/worker" "npm run dev --workspace @aishield/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @aishield/api
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @aishield/worker
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @aishield/web
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
